the sixteen cases were cut against the predecessor manifest law and case none of the fields this manifest gained on 2026-08-09; a candidate that omits every new field still passes every case probe
incomparability: A score is a property of target x model x harness x benchmark. Scores do not cross this benchmark identity, nor a change of model id, effort level, host binding or scaffold. No harness offset is subtracted: the effect is candidate-dependent, so one correction term is wrong for every candidate but one. A claim spanning the boundary re-runs every retained candidate and reports paired per-case verdicts and the count of sign flips, never a rank correlation over two candidates.
